reviews.text: Out of a few I've tried, only this one consistently & reliably does its thing (I'm using Edge). Works on every page without exception (no "special pages" where it can't work). Recognizes every closed tab (others sometimes fail to do so & then try to go/switch to a tab that doesn't exist). Also, handles each window independently (some may prefer otherwise, but for me it's perfect). Was apprehensive about compatibility (given that it's not very recently updated), but this extension works, while others, more newly updated, don't.
reviews.dev_reply: I appreciate you taking time to leave a review [name]. I'm glad the extension is helpful, I'm using it daily also.
